what: observe (explore-web questions 6 and 8). blaze-profile has two new history tables, `links` and `crate_deps` (schema.rs, facts.rs), written at the next flush from `History::linked(rows)` and `History::crate_graph(rows)`. Please call them where the daemon hands its BuildRow to the history (serve/observe.rs, the `ended` path): 1) links: for each `(image, Linking)` of the request's links (job.rs `link_kind` reads them), a `facts::LinkRow { build_id, image, krate: the package, outcome: if how.placed() { LinkOutcome::Placed } else { LinkOutcome::Patched }, dur_ns: the link's time if Linking has it }`. 2) crate_deps: once a build, from the plan's resolved graph, one `facts::CrateDepRow { build_id, krate, dep, kind: DepKind::Normal|Build|Dev }` per edge of the units built. Unbuilt on my side; test history `the_images_a_build_linked_and_its_crate_graph_are_written_at_the_next_flush`.

history.note: Each ended build reaches the history as observe::Ended { row, links, crate_deps }; keep() calls History::linked and crate_graph before build_ended, so the build flush writes them. links: one LinkRow per image a unit linked; image is `<target> (<first kind>)`, krate is the package name, outcome Placed/Patched from Linking::placed, dur_ns None (Linking carries no time). crate_deps: from the build units edges, Build from a build script compile, Dev where only a dev-dependency makes the edge (new schema::UnitDep::dev, set from graph.rs Dep::dev, serialized only when true), else Normal; edges within one package, to or from a script run or std are left out; sorted and deduplicated. Tests: blaze-units load an_edge_only_a_dev_dependency_makes_says_so; blaze-cargo job a_builds_crate_graph_has_an_edge_for_each_table_a_dependency_is_in. rust-analyzer clean; unbuilt.
